metadata.name: HKFRS / IFRS Hong Kong-China Extraction Ontology
changes: Initial HK/China ontology generated from the HKFRS/IFRS template.
Added the 'Gross profit' (毛利) face subtotal concept (pl_gross_profit) with its accounting definition, inclusion/exclusion criteria and bilingual aliases.

Added plain HKFRS/IFRS face-line wordings and Traditional Chinese aliases used in HKEX filings (Revenue 收益, Cost of sales 銷售成本, Other income and gains 其他收入及收益, Selling and marketing expenses 銷售及營銷開支, Administrative expenses 行政開支, Finance costs 財務費用, Profit/(loss) before tax 除稅前溢利, Income tax expense 稅項開支, Loss for the year 年內虧損) to the existing profit-or-loss mappings.

Coverage (HKEX property developer, China SCE AR2023): added the current-asset concepts Properties under development (發展中物業), Completed properties held for sale (持作出售已落成物業), Restricted cash (受限制現金), Due from related parties (應收關聯方款項) and Prepaid income tax (預付稅項), the current-liability mirror Due to related parties (應付關聯方款項), the non-current Interests in joint ventures (於合營公司的投資), and the face line Other expenses (其他開支) — whose absence had let administrative expenses absorb it.

Added the balance-sheet subtotals NET CURRENT ASSETS/(LIABILITIES) (流動資產╱（負債）淨額) and TOTAL ASSETS LESS CURRENT LIABILITIES (總資產減流動負債). The latter previously resolved to bs_current_liabilities__total_current_liabilities on token overlap; the two are now separated by their own aliases, by reciprocal confusable_with, by exclusion criteria naming the other line, and by regex_hints/exclude_hints so the rule tier can never cross-fire.

Split the profit-or-loss bottom line from the total-comprehensive bottom line: added pl_other_comprehensive_income_for_the_year (年內其他全面虧損) and pl_total_comprehensive_income_for_the_year (年內全面虧損總額). On a bilingual HKEX statement of comprehensive income the wrapped caption 'TOTAL COMPREHENSIVE / LOSS FOR THE YEAR' reaches the matcher as the bare fragment 'LOSS FOR THE YEAR'; the total-comprehensive concept is declared before pl_profit_for_the_year so that fragment resolves to it, while pl_profit_for_the_year carries bilingual anchors ('LOSS FOR THE YEAR 年內虧損') and keeps its own row. Both concepts state the other in exclude/confusable_with.

Added the attribution lines pl_profit_attributable_to__owners_of_the_parent (母公司擁有人) and pl_profit_attributable_to__non_controlling_interests (非控股權益) as period FLOWS, distinct from the balance-sheet equity NCI balance, and the separately-presented share of profits and losses of associates (應佔聯營公司損益) and of joint ventures (應佔合營公司損益) as children of the combined face line.

Added the total-comprehensive attribution lines (pl_total_comprehensive_income_attributable_to__owners_of_the_parent / __non_controlling_interests, HKAS 1.81B(b)) so the OCI attribution captions no longer fall onto the profit attribution lines — the two carry different amounts.

Total equity now also recognises the net-assets-format caption 'Net assets' (資產淨值) — the same reported amount under HKFRS — and 'Net current assets/(liabilities)' excludes it explicitly, so the two 淨額/淨值 lines cannot be confused.
